name: athena
description: Amazon Athena is an interactive query service that lets you use standard SQL to analyze data directly in Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: batch-get-named-query
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a single named query or a list of up to 50 queries, which you provide as an array of query ID strings.

subcommands.name: batch-get-prepared-statement
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a single prepared statement or a list of up to 256 prepared statements for the array of prepared statement names that you provide.

subcommands.name: batch-get-query-execution
subcommands.description: Returns the details of a single query execution or a list of up to 50 query executions, which you provide as an array of query execution ID strings.

subcommands.name: cancel-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Cancels the capacity reservation with the specified name.

subcommands.name: create-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Creates a capacity reservation with the specified name and number of requested data processing units.

subcommands.name: create-data-catalog
subcommands.description: Creates (registers) a data catalog with the specified name and properties.

subcommands.name: create-named-query
subcommands.description: Creates a named query in the specified workgroup.

subcommands.name: create-notebook
subcommands.description: Creates an empty ipynb file in the specified Apache Spark enabled workgroup.

subcommands.name: create-prepared-statement
subcommands.description: Creates a prepared statement for use with SQL queries in Athena.

subcommands.name: create-presigned-notebook-url
subcommands.description: Gets an authentication token and the URL at which the notebook can be accessed.

subcommands.name: create-work-group
subcommands.description: Creates a workgroup with the specified name.

subcommands.name: delete-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Deletes a cancelled capacity reservation.

subcommands.name: delete-data-catalog
subcommands.description: Deletes a data catalog.

subcommands.name: delete-named-query
subcommands.description: Deletes the named query if you have access to the workgroup in which the query was saved.

subcommands.name: delete-notebook
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified notebook.

subcommands.name: delete-prepared-statement
subcommands.description: Deletes the prepared statement with the specified name from the specified workgroup.

subcommands.name: delete-work-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the workgroup with the specified name.

subcommands.name: export-notebook
subcommands.description: Exports the specified notebook and its metadata.

subcommands.name: get-calculation-execution
subcommands.description: Describes a previously submitted calculation execution.

subcommands.name: get-calculation-execution-code
subcommands.description: Retrieves the unencrypted code that was executed for the calculation.

subcommands.name: get-calculation-execution-status
subcommands.description: Gets the status of a current calculation.

subcommands.name: get-capacity-assignment-configuration
subcommands.description: Gets the capacity assignment configuration for a capacity reservation, if one exists.

subcommands.name: get-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Returns information about the capacity reservation with the specified name.

subcommands.name: get-data-catalog
subcommands.description: Returns the specified data catalog.

subcommands.name: get-database
subcommands.description: Returns a database object for the specified database and data catalog.

subcommands.name: get-named-query
subcommands.description: Returns information about a single query.

subcommands.name: get-notebook-metadata
subcommands.description: Retrieves notebook metadata for the specified notebook ID.

subcommands.name: get-prepared-statement
subcommands.description: Retrieves the prepared statement with the specified name from the specified workgroup.

subcommands.name: get-query-execution
subcommands.description: Returns information about a single execution of a query if you have access to the workgroup in which the query ran.

subcommands.name: get-query-results
subcommands.description: Streams the results of a single query execution specified by QueryExecutionId from the Athena query results location in Amazon S3.

subcommands.name: get-query-runtime-statistics
subcommands.description: Returns query execution runtime statistics related to a single execution of a query if you have access to the workgroup in which the query ran.

subcommands.name: get-resource-dashboard
subcommands.description: Gets the Live UI/Persistence UI for a session.

subcommands.name: get-session
subcommands.description: Gets the full details of a previously created session, including the session status and configuration.

subcommands.name: get-session-endpoint
subcommands.description: Gets a connection endpoint and authentication token for a given session Id.

subcommands.name: get-session-status
subcommands.description: Gets the current status of a session.

subcommands.name: get-table-metadata
subcommands.description: Returns table metadata for the specified catalog, database, and table.

subcommands.name: get-work-group
subcommands.description: Returns information about the workgroup with the specified name.

subcommands.name: import-notebook
subcommands.description: Imports a single ipynb file to a Spark enabled workgroup.

subcommands.name: list-application-dpu-sizes
subcommands.description: Returns the supported DPU sizes for the supported application runtimes (for example, Athena notebook version 1).

subcommands.name: list-calculation-executions
subcommands.description: Lists the calculations that have been submitted to a session in descending order.

subcommands.name: list-capacity-reservations
subcommands.description: Lists the capacity reservations for the current account.

subcommands.name: list-data-catalogs
subcommands.description: Lists the data catalogs in the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-databases
subcommands.description: Lists the databases in the specified data catalog.

subcommands.name: list-engine-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of engine versions that are available to choose from, including the Auto option.

subcommands.name: list-executors
subcommands.description: Lists, in descending order, the executors that joined a session.

subcommands.name: list-named-queries
subcommands.description: Provides a list of available query IDs only for queries saved in the specified workgroup.

subcommands.name: list-notebook-metadata
subcommands.description: Displays the notebook files for the specified workgroup in paginated format.

subcommands.name: list-notebook-sessions
subcommands.description: Lists, in descending order, the sessions that have been created in a notebook that are in an active state like CREATING, CREATED, IDLE or BUSY.

subcommands.name: list-prepared-statements
subcommands.description: Lists the prepared statements in the specified workgroup.

subcommands.name: list-query-executions
subcommands.description: Provides a list of available query execution IDs for the queries in the specified workgroup.

subcommands.name: list-sessions
subcommands.description: Lists the sessions in a workgroup that are in an active state like CREATING, CREATED, IDLE, or BUSY.

subcommands.name: list-table-metadata
subcommands.description: Lists the metadata for the tables in the specified data catalog database.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags associated with an Athena resource.

subcommands.name: list-work-groups
subcommands.description: Lists available workgroups for the account.

subcommands.name: put-capacity-assignment-configuration
subcommands.description: Puts a new capacity assignment configuration for a specified capacity reservation.

subcommands.name: start-calculation-execution
subcommands.description: Submits calculations for execution within a session.

subcommands.name: start-query-execution
subcommands.description: Runs the SQL query statements contained in the Query.

subcommands.name: start-session
subcommands.description: Creates a session for running calculations within a workgroup.

subcommands.name: stop-calculation-execution
subcommands.description: Requests the cancellation of a calculation.

subcommands.name: stop-query-execution
subcommands.description: Stops a query execution.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an Athena resource.

subcommands.name: terminate-session
subcommands.description: Terminates an active session.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from an Athena resource.

subcommands.name: update-capacity-reservation
subcommands.description: Updates the number of requested data processing units for the capacity reservation with the specified name.

subcommands.name: update-data-catalog
subcommands.description: Updates the data catalog that has the specified name.

subcommands.name: update-named-query
subcommands.description: Updates a NamedQuery object.

subcommands.name: update-notebook
subcommands.description: Updates the contents of a Spark notebook.

subcommands.name: update-notebook-metadata
subcommands.description: Updates the metadata for a notebook.

subcommands.name: update-prepared-statement
subcommands.description: Updates a prepared statement.

subcommands.name: update-work-group
subcommands.description: Updates the workgroup with the specified name.
